spans.s: एध r. 1st cl. (एधते) To grow or increase.

एध m. (-धः) Fuel, as wood, grass, &c.
 E. एध् to increase, घञ् aff.

. Fire.
 E. एध्
to increase, तु Unādi aff.

एधनीय mfn. (-तः-या-यं) To be enlarged or increased.
 E. एध् to grow, and
अनीयर् affix; also एधितव्य and एध्य.

एधस् n. (-धः) Fuel: see एध.
 E. एध् to grow, Unādi affix असुन्.
